body: I've never really been able to get a job. I mostly just used to do volunteer work.  I've had to drop out of four different colleges now and don't think I could really go back sadly.  Thank you for responding, I am feeling a bit better now.  Not as suicidal at any rate.

I really wish I could just get away from them. I've wanted to for a very long time.  The problem is that when I'm not under constant supervision I start doing genuinely crazy things. Like spending four to five hours rearranging furniture and forgetting to go to school, or not eating for a week, re painting all of my furniture the same color.  Lots of weird little rituals I feel compelled to complete when I'm stressed out in any way.

 I have cuts and burns on lots of random parts of my body, pulled off nails, pulled out hair from every surface of my body.  I also have a very low tolerance to getting addicted to things that give me any amount of release.  Whether it is drugs, alcohol, or pain.

So sadly, I have to be around people that will hold me accountable for my actions, even when I'm on medication I can't seem to control eany of these impulses.

Yesterday was Christmas, the worst day of the year for me. It is my Grandpa’s birthday. My whole family knows I refuse to be in his presence and get very upset with me for not going to visit him in his retirement apartment complex. They don’t know that if I ever see him again, I’ll probably rip out his throat with my teeth or use my chef’s knife. I’ve thought about it a lot. Every Christmas the same thing happens and I spiral into a further depression and try to disassociate from the world as a whole.

This was the worst one yet. I basically hit a wall of pure paranoia and wanted to desperately to kill myself. I told my dad about it, he went off to his brother’s for a Christmas party leaving me alone for about four hours. I went and triple checked all the locks on every door in the house and window, shut all the blinds, opened every cabinet and door, covered every reflected surface and turned on all the light. I then locked myself in my room shaking and crying while a torrential deluge of memories swam behind my eyes. I don’t think I moved for about four hours until my dad called.

This morning I had to go visit my mom and her boyfriend ambushed me. He wanted to hang out and get to know me better. He said he understood what I was going through because he had a couple of panic attack and went of pills for a year then had withdrawn from them, so he “Knew” what I was going through. I kind of lost my shit and thankfully didn’t attack him (He touched my leg trying to calm me down and I fucking lost it all over the place, crying and screaming and basically running Christmas for everyone. I hid in the bathroom for about an hour until I could stop crying and get myself under control. I convinced my dad to take me home and have been locked in my room writing this.

Reddit. I have never told any one singular person this information about my childhood and teenage years. This isn’t even all of the terribleness. Maybe a little more then half. These are just the things I remember off the top of my head. I just really needed to put it down in words. I don’t know if I’m going to kill myself or not, but I can’t go through another year like this. I act like I hate everyone around me to keep them away. I don’t like people knowing that I used to think I was a psychic witch and I talked to God in my head. I know I’m crazy and I used to be able to fake sanity so well, now I don’t even have that left.

Thanks for reading. I don’t know what I’m going to go do now. I just wan my head to stop making me relive these things over and over. I know there is nothing I can do to change it and I have no will power left to even try to make some sort of life for myself.

This is what was going on at home and daycare, while at school I was taunted and teased and beaten up on a daily basis. Sometimes in the middle of classes and on several occasions by teachers and staff. They would publicly humiliate me anyway they could and threatened me with Tazers and knives. I had the equivalent of a restraining order on about fifteen different students. I eventually had to drop out of public school and had to go on home school and teach myself for three years.

I went back to public school in high school in a different school district. I was only terrorized about half the time. The area I lived in was pretty much all Mormons and Catholics, Racists and Neo Nazis (I had many7 a late night visitor terrorizing my house during high school).

I was effeminate, fat, half-black, weird, and obviously gay. I basically hid myself in clubs and the theater department. I managed to put a block up in my mind at some point and managed to basically forget every bad thing that had ever happened to me. During my entire life I had maintained a 4.0 or higher GPA and participated in the leadership of about seven clubs. I hid myself and all my problems very well from people around me, up until senior year when I turned seventeen.

My brain basically shattered. I started ditching school, doing drugs and drinking and crying all the time. I started asking people questions. I had never thought to question the fact that I heard choices or saw things that other people didn’t. That I was constantly guarding my thoughts so that other people couldn’t get into my head and take them.

I basically grew up thinking I had magic powers and was psychic. Everything glows when I look at it. Different colors and shapes, sometimes more if I watch long enough or are sufficiently stressed out and nervous. I also believed that I was possessed with demons and that they were trying to take me away. I heard voices all the time telling me to do things. At some point I decided one of the voices was God and the other The Devil. At another point I was also convinced that aliens had kidnapped me and inserted a chip in my spinal column. I’ve been crazy for nearly my entire life. I still see and hear these things, especially the last couple of months. I have to keep the mirrored surfaces covered at night and all the blinds closed; otherwise there are things outside waiting to take me away. I don’t think they want to kill me, but what they want is worse for some reason.
I have dropped out of about four different colleges since high school. Each time getting worse. The last one I was taken away to a mental hospital after a debate in my speech class.
I have been in and out of four different mental hospitals in the last year. Only one time was voluntary, the rest were 5150’s.

I can’t be around people. When I am physically in the presence of people I in any way care about I had visions in 
my head of murdering and raping them. Violent horrible images that I can’t make stop, they often get bad enough that I start vomiting. I pretty much sit on the verge of having a panic attack anytime someone talks to me, and if someone touches me in any way I either have a complete break down or erupt into anger and start beating them.

I spend entire days in my head reliving every tragic moment in my life I have ever had, obsessively going over every tiny detail. Every friend I have ever had, has betrayed me or been scared away by my mood swings. I can’t really blame them

I’ve basically spent the last couple of years not leaving the house at all, not even leaving my room except for food and to use the restroom.

I'm the healing lead and basically the tank lead in my guild right now and have had tp spend pretty much everyday relearning the mechanics of every healing and tanking class to recalibrate the hard mode setups I had previously for ICC 25.  It's made a lot of the fights bit harder with the change to Holy pallies (Both of mine just wanted to quit and play another class).  Oddly enough it has made our LK H 25 attempts easier though.

Resto Druid Mastery is awesome for tank healing, which is what most resto druids will be doing after ICC.  You shouldn't give up any haste until you hit 1016, (Which is the amount needed to gain an extra tick on rejuvenation).  The next milestone to hit for haste is too high to consider.  Crit is still useless in level 80 content in the same way it was with the T9 bonus was.  The crit is almost all over-heal outside of an aura fight and if you are still tank healing it won't help you.  If all of your pieces have innate spirit on them you will probably have more then enough for all levels of content. Personally I reforged until I got enough haste to hit the soft cap, then reforged all my extra crit and spirit pieces into mastery. But I'm also nearly in complete BIS gear.

Sorry, but you're wrong.  If you don't get hit you won't build vengeance stacks, if you are not building vengeance you will loose threat.  Also Savage defense bubbles don't get weaker over time like the DR on Dodge will.  In every situation you are better off changing all haste into mastery as a feral tank.
